resources.string: This service helps populate delivery fields from the Uber Driver app.

Split test: open Android Auto home, tap Ranger Profit HUD from the launcher or dock, then let the host choose the companion pane. Use desktop-head-unit -c dhu/wide-split.ini. If it still opens full-screen, that host is not allowing this template app in split view.
